{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep only the row with highest sample_seq per patient
deduplicated_data = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Count unique patients after deduplication
num_unique_patients = deduplicated_data['patient_id'].nunique()

# Confirm this matches the earlier count of unique patient_ids (should be 800)
print(f'Deduplicated number of unique patients: {num_unique_patients}')"}
